The texts are SD-7 r1's, and the effective NE equals r1's complete copy byte for byte; no copy is made and NE stays selected. Binds only after VD2-a and F8c are integrated; an earlier verify_design refuses it. Existing codes only: no new public code, class, exit, D9 member, schema, WS, SL or product change. The exact frozen candidate requires actual independent review, whose review lists supersededPassages, and root assent.
